links.outcome: ENT resident resectability classification accuracy and completion time with versus without AI assistance
links.effect: CoT-assisted residents 97.3% (GPT-5.5) and 98.0% (DeepSeek-V3) vs 72.8% unassisted, p<0.001; 43.0% reduction in completion time. Overreliance not assessed.
links.quote: Furthermore, CoT-assisted ENT residents demonstrated significantly greater accuracy than unassisted peers (GPT-5.5: 97.3% vs. 72.8%, p < 0.001; DeepSeek-V3: 98.0% vs. 72.8%, p < 0.001), alongside a 43.0% reduction in completion time (95% CI: 41.5%-44.4%; p < 0.001).

links.outcome: Clinician-in-training performance when using AI-generated reports versus unaided
links.effect: AI-assisted residents were more accurate (97.3%-98.0% vs 72.8%, p<0.001) and 43.0% faster than unassisted residents.
links.quote: While AI-generated reports improved surgeons' accuracy and efficiency, these models should be further validated as support tools before widespread clinical implementation.
